title: Informational Advisory: SonicOS Client DPI-SSL Trust of Compromised eMudhra Certificate Chain
summary:
SonicWall has addressed an issue in SonicOS where appliances with Client DPI-SSL enabled continued to trust certificate chains issued by compromised eMudhra intermediate Certificate Authorities (CAs). Because the firewall’s local certificate store trusted the underlying root certificates, the firewall re-signed traffic from impacted servers with the local SonicWall DPI-SSL CA certificate, preventing client browsers from rejecting connections signed by the untrusted intermediate CAs.

title: End-Of-Life (EOL) SonicWall GMS Multiple Vulnerabilities
summary:
1) CVE-2026-109593 - End-of-Life (EOL) SonicWall GMS Unauthenticated File Read Vulnerability

An unauthenticated attacker with network access to the SonicWall GMS 9.5.2 and earlier versions may be able to read internal GMS files, potentially exposing sensitive information.

CVSS Score: 9.1
CVSS Vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:H
CWE-636: Not Failing Securely ('Failing Open')

title: Common UNIX Printing System (CUPS) Vulnerabilities
summary:
Common UNIX Printing System (CUPS) is an open-source printing system for Linux and other UNIX-like operating systems. CUPS uses the IPP (Internet Printing Protocol) to allow for printing with local and network printers. By combining these vulnerabilities (CVE-2024-47076, CVE-2024-47177, CVE-2024-47175, and CVE-2024-47176), an attacker could potentially execute remote code, which may result in the theft of sensitive information and/or cause damage to essential production systems.

title: CVE-2024-6387: regreSSHion RCE in OpenSSH Vulnerability
summary:
A signal handler race condition was found in OpenSSH's server (sshd), where a client does not authenticate within LoginGraceTime seconds (120 by default, 600 in old OpenSSH versions), then sshd's SIGALRM handler is called asynchronously. However, this signal handler calls various functions that are not async-signal-safe, for example, syslog().
